notes.title: Fight the virus, stay at home SALE
notes.notes:
Due to the recent outbreaks of Covid-19 most of us have been urged to stay at home to prevent further spread of the virus. And because staying at home is more fun if you can play videogames, I decided to put ALL of my games on sale for 50% off.

Stay at home, stop the virus! And enjoy gaming while you save lives :)
